notes:
The bigger an animated element is, the slower it should move. Notice how the hand on the right moves much slower than the cursors on the left. That’s because it feels heavier. The same applies to distance. The more an element has to travel, the longer the animation should be.

Designer: @emilkowalski. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
